name: Finance
description: Private money accounts and transactions. You can list your accounts, add manual accounts and transactions, connect a bank and pull its balances and transactions every six hours or on demand, sort and review transactions, set rules, split, add notes, import a CSV bank file, and plan a monthly budget with drafts. It also plans bills, sets targets, shares a flexible pool and reserves money for card payments. You can share a bank account with the household, read spending and net worth reports, export your history, review the activity list and undo a change, and archive an empty category. The Finance screen shows the budget, transactions and accounts.

finance.accounts.list.description: List your accounts, currencies, current balances and bank sync status. Manual account balances come from the ledger. Account names are outside content.

finance.manual.context.description: Read manual entry setup. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.manual.account-create.description: Add a manual account. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.manual.entry-create.description: Add a manual transaction. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.transactions.query.description: List your transactions for a month, with filters, notes, splits and review state. Payee names and notes are outside content.

finance.transactions.categorize.description: Put a transaction you have seen before into a category. Moss's guess is trusted without asking by default.

finance.transactions.categorize-new.description: Put a transaction from a new payee into a category. This asks each time by default.

finance.transactions.review-apply.description: Confirm or change the category of transactions that need a look, optionally saving a rule.

finance.transactions.bulk-categorize.description: Put several transactions into one category.

finance.transactions.bulk-confirm.description: Confirm several transactions that Moss sorted.

finance.transactions.notes.read.description: Read the note on one transaction. Notes are outside content.

finance.transactions.notes.save.description: Save the note on one transaction.

finance.transactions.splits.description: Split a transaction across categories, or remove the split.

finance.rule.set.description: Always put a payee into a category from now on.

finance.rules.preview.description: Show which transactions a payee rule would change, without changing any.

finance.import.preview.description: Check a parsed bank file for duplicates before importing. Nothing is saved.

finance.import.apply.description: Import rows from a bank file into a manual account. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

finance.connect.start.description: Start linking a bank, or reconnect one that needs a new sign-in. Returns a page address for the person to open. Needs approval.

finance.connect.poll.description: Check whether the person has finished the bank page and, if so, save the bank and pull its first data.

finance.sync.run-now.description: Pull the latest balances and transactions from every connected bank now.

finance.budget.configure.description: Choose the budget currency once and start the saved category list. The currency cannot be changed later.

finance.budget.status.description: Read one month of the budget: money in each category, what is ready to assign, and the review numbers a save needs.

finance.budget.assign.description: Set the amount assigned to one category for a month.

finance.budget.move.description: Move money between two categories, or from ready to assign into a category, for one month.

finance.budget.apply.description: Save the amounts for one category or a batch of up to 20 categories for a month, as the person typed them.

finance.budget.draft.build.description: Build a first budget draft from the last three full months of saved spending.

finance.budget.draft.update.description: Change, add or drop one line of the open budget draft.

finance.budget.draft.start.description: Turn the open draft into this month's budget amounts.

finance.transactions.export.description: Prepare a spreadsheet of your own transaction history. Another person's shared rows are never included. Payee names are outside content.

finance.reports.spending.description: Read your monthly spending report, with other people's shared accounts listed apart.

finance.reports.net-worth.description: Read your net worth over time. Net worth is never shared with other people.

finance.reports.transactions.description: List the transactions behind one report figure. Payee names are outside content.

finance.activity.list.description: List recent changes made to your finance data, with whether each can be undone.

finance.account.set-shared.description: Share a bank account with the household, or stop sharing it. Others see balances and transactions, never notes.

finance.category.archive.description: Archive a category that holds no budget money. Income and transfers cannot be archived.

finance.activity.undo.description: Undo one earlier change, such as a category choice, if nothing has moved on since.

finance.bills.read.description: Read the bill plans and the coming bills for a month.

finance.bills.suggestions.description: Suggest bills found in saved spending.

finance.bill.entry-preview.description: Preview the entry that would record a bill as paid.

finance.flex.preview.description: Preview a flexible pool for a month.

finance.bill.decide.description: Confirm, skip or match one coming bill.

finance.bill.adjust.description: Change the amount or date of one coming bill.

finance.bill.adjust-reset.description: Put one coming bill back to its plan.

finance.bill.entry-record.description: Record a bill as paid with a manual entry.

finance.targets.fund.description: Fund targets from what is ready to assign.

finance.flex.configure.description: Choose which categories share the flexible pool.

finance.flex.assign.description: Set the total of the flexible pool.

finance.card-reserve.save.description: Enroll a card or set its payment reserve.

navigation.label: Finance
navigation.description: Your budget by month, a searchable list of transactions you can sort into categories, and your accounts with balances, net worth and bank connection status.

features.description: A person can list their own accounts with current balances, currencies and, for manual accounts, the opening date and balance. With no accounts, the list suggests adding a manual account. Accounts shared by other people and bank links are not built yet. The Finance screen shows it.

errors.description: Accounts could not be read. Try again in a moment.

features.description: A person can add a private manual account (checking, savings, cash, credit, loan or asset) in one of twelve currencies, with an opening date that is not in the future and an opening balance. Repeating the same operation id with the same values changes nothing. The assistant's version needs the account's one-use approval. No bank money is moved.

features.description: A person can add a manual transaction to a manual account. It moves the account balance (down for cash-like accounts, up for credit and loans), needs a current category or is marked for a look, and cannot be dated before the account opened, in a reconciled period or in the future. Repeating the same operation id with the same values changes nothing. The assistant's version needs the account's one-use approval.

errors.description: Choose a current category. Linked transfers need their own workflow.

features.description: A person can list their own transactions for a month with filters, search, notes and splits. They can set or change a category, confirm what Moss sorted, save a note, split a transaction across categories, and sort many at once. Moss sorts by payee rule first, then the bank's own category, and only confirms on its own when the sorting tier allows it. The Finance screen shows it.

features.description: A person can list payee rules, preview what a rule would change, and turn rules on, off or remove them. A rule always confirms the category it sets.

features.description: A person can read a CSV bank file of up to 1 MiB and 200 rows, check the rows against what is already saved, choose what to do with each duplicate, and import the rest into a manual account. Importing the same file twice with the same operation id saves it once. No bank money is moved.

features.description: A person can link a bank. Starting returns a page address to open, the person signs in there, and a check then saves the bank and pulls its first accounts and transactions. Starting again for a bank that needs a new sign-in reconnects it without a second copy. The assistant's version of starting needs a one-use approval. The bank's sign-in token never leaves the host.

errors.description: The bank service is not set up or could not start the link. Check the bank service keys in settings, then try again.
The saved bank sign-in could not be read. Try again, or reconnect the bank.

features.description: Balances and transactions for every connected bank are pulled every six hours and on request. Each bank is handled on its own, so one failing bank never stops the others. If the bank changes its pages during a read, Moss retries from the start of that read, up to three times. A bank that needs a new sign-in is marked as needing a reconnect and keeps its saved data. A person's own category and note on a bank transaction are kept, and manual entries are never overwritten. Categorizing new transactions is not built yet.

A person can choose a budget currency once, see a month of the budget with each category's assigned, spent and available money and what is ready to assign, set the amount for one category or up to 20 at once, and move money between categories or from ready to assign. Every save needs the review numbers from the screen. If the budget or the ledger changed since, nothing is saved. The Finance screen shows the budget. Flexible pools, targets, card payments and bills are not built yet.
